description: The package draws `title="Expand"` on an SVG `<use>` after its `xlink:href`: `[0, 'xlink', 'href', '#pct-widget-icon', 'title', 'Expand']` in `consts`, the shape measured through ngc and the linker, and no source writes it — a `dist` built before the template lost it. `0` marks a namespaced attribute, which takes three slots, and ordinary pairs go on after it. A package read stopping at the first number lost the title.
